## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, previous behavior and behavior after this change.

## Requirement / decision

Link the actual Issue (`Closes #...`), accepted RFC/ADR or anchored backlog item. Replace this instruction with the reference and explain which acceptance criteria are met.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results, including relevant failure-path checks. For UI changes include the tested interaction and screenshots where useful. Explain any local limitations.

## Compatibility and recovery

Describe data migration, component/protocol version changes and rollback or recovery steps, or explain why they are unnecessary.

## Review

- [ ] I reviewed the final diff, failure paths and affected permission/data boundaries.
- [ ] Tests and documentation cover the resulting behavior.
- [ ] User-visible changes are recorded in CHANGELOG, or this is an internal-only change.
- [ ] No private research data, credentials or generated release artifacts are included.
